banner.alt: 70mai Dash Cam 4K Omni. The Next-Gen 360° Dash Cam with Dual Brilliance. TIME Best Inventions 2025, Red Dot winner 2025.

spotlight.title: 4K@60FPS* Unrivaled Clarity
spotlight.body: 4K 3840x2160 resolution, delivering an immersive visual experience. Its ultra-high definition brings unrivaled clarity, allowing you to precisely zoom in and capture every intricate detail. Furthermore, with our MaiColor Vivid+ Solution™, intelligent auto-exposure is no longer simply an average brightness adjustment. Instead, it simulates the human visual system to optimize for various scenes. By selectively processing image information, it highlights key elements and suppresses noise, resulting in a significant improvement in image quality and providing stronger assurance for driving safety.
spotlight.note: *4K 60FPS is exclusive to single-channel mode, while dual-channel mode supports up to 4K 30FPS.

feature_sections.title: AI Motion Detection 2.0
feature_sections.body: We've made significant optimizations to address the issue of insensitive motion detection. By combining dual Hall effect sensors and a magnetic system, we've dramatically improved lens positioning accuracy. Additionally, a smooth 340° pan ensures 360° coverage without blind spots. Our AI algorithms have also been upgraded, enabling precise tracking of both single and multiple targets, as well as fast-moving objects. The system can intelligently adapt to various motion scenarios. Once a potential target is detected, the device will automatically focus, track, and initiate a 30-second pre- and post-recording to ensure critical evidence is captured.

feature_sections.title: 70mai Night Owl Vision™
feature_sections.body: The 70mai Night Owl Vision™ is another exclusive technology that produces clearer nighttime images with less noise, balanced exposure, and improved glare control. Even the license plates in the distance are clear and distinguishable. Upon zooming in, a distinct contrast emerges.

feature_sections.title: Dual Vision, Dual Brilliance
feature_sections.body: The front and rear dual recording delivers a comprehensive, multi-angle view, and significant breakthroughs have been made in image quality. Both cameras support HDR recording and feature image sensors with the Sony STARVIS 2 technology, larger pixel sizes for enhanced light capture, delivering sharper, more detailed footage even in low-light settings.
feature_sections.note: *Compared to the Sony STARVIS image sensor; data sourced from Sony.

feature_sections.title: Supercapacitor
feature_sections.body: The 4K Omni withstands extreme working temperatures ranging from -40°C ~ 85°C (-40°F ~ 185°F) and boasts an impressive lifespan capable of handling hundreds of thousands of charge cycles without sacrificing performance. Pairing with the 70mai battery offers a more robust solution for safeguarding the car battery and avoiding insurance coverage that has lapsed.

feature_sections.title: 4G LTE Connectivity
feature_sections.body: The 4G connectivity ensures uninterrupted communication with your vehicle from any location.
feature_sections.note: *The 4G hardwire kit is required, sold separately, and is available in select countries.

cards.title: Instant App Alert
cards.body: When your car is parked, it sends instant notifications to your phone in the event of a collision.

cards.title: Find My Car
cards.body: Easily locate your car in busy areas and provide walking navigation via the App.

cards.title: Live Route Tracking & Streaming
cards.body: Upgraded to support real-time remote tracking at all times, it allows you to monitor the live driving route remotely via the App, keeping informed of your car's status when someone else is driving it.

feature_sections.title: Voice Control & MaiX In-Car AI Mate
feature_sections.body: Where Smart, Fun, and Engaging Design Meets Technical Excellence. The 4K Omni is more than just a dash cam! It's your in-car AI Mate that listens to you and interacts with you! Voice control now goes beyond English and Mandarin, with added support for Italian, giving even more options to go hands-free. The LED glow ring provides instant feedback on working status, illuminating red to alert you to any suspicious activity.

feature_sections.title: 70mai Lumi Vision
feature_sections.body: Introducing the latest advancement specifically designed for night parking mode, 70mai Lumi Vision. It's customized to enhance brightness in low-light parking environments. So, you'll get vibrant, high-clarity footage even in the darkest conditions, ensuring enhanced visibility and protection for your vehicle, day or night.

feature_sections.title: High-Speed Transfer
feature_sections.body: Upgrade with Wi-Fi 6 5GHz, delivering download speeds of up to 20MB/s. Now, you can download a 200MB video in just 10 seconds.
feature_sections.note: *Download speeds can fluctuate due to factors such as environmental conditions and the smartphone used.

feature_sections.title: Built-in GPS
feature_sections.body: The built-in GPS captures speed, time, and precise coordinates, seamlessly logged for review in the 70mai App, offering proof of travel and route optimization.

feature_sections.title: Super-Sensing ADAS
feature_sections.body: Warn you in advance to avoid traffic safety risks: lane departure, forward collision, forward vehicle start, and adding identifications on pedestrians and cyclists to provide an extra layer of safety for your journey.

feature_sections.title: Upgraded Buffered Emergency Recording
feature_sections.body: Extending the buffer beyond 10 seconds (up to 3 minutes). It captures the pre-collision buffer, the exact moment of impact, and 30 seconds of post-collision footage, ensuring all crucial moments are recorded.

feature_sections.title: Road Story Filter
feature_sections.body: The road story filter sprinkles a dash of driving data and visual effects on your footage, conjuring up an epic, sci-fi vibe during playback. Experience the thrill and share your odyssey with friends, transforming ordinary journeys into extraordinary memories.

faqs.question: What is the night vision enhancement function of this model? What are its advantages?

answer.text: This model is equipped with large aperture lens and starlight night vision level image sensors, allowing for superior low-light imaging capabilities, which are supplemented by specially optimized imaging parameters for night driving and night parking security. In scenarios with dim lighting, such as traveling at night on roads without street lights, parking in parking lots with dim lighting, dim underground garage, etc., the dash cam can provide outstanding image quality for image algorithm analysis and evidence acquiring.

The Road Story Filter is a visual effect feature available on high-end 70mai dash cam models. When the Road Story Filter is enabled, visually appealing effects will be overlaid on top of the footage during playback of normal or emergency video clips in the app. These effects will display information such as vehicle speed, direction of travel, altitude, pitch angle, tilt angle, the lane depiction, and the distance to the front vehicle. With Road Story Filter, you can recall your driving experience vividly from a perspective and sensation similar to racing games, or analyze causes of accidents in greater detail.

The battery protection voltage threshold can be gradually adjusted based on the actual situation of your vehicle's battery capacity and age, so that you can use the sentinel mode for the longest possible time while protecting your battery.

faqs.question: What is motion detection? When does this function trigger the recording of parking surveillance video?

answer.text: If you have enabled the motion detection function in the dash cam settings. After the vehicle engine has been switched off and enters sentinel mode, the dash cam will continue to record and the built-in AI algorithm will continue to analyze the scene in the field of view. In the event that the ongoing image algorithm of the dash cam determines that the level of threat by a moving object has reached the recording threshold, the dash cam records a 30-second parking surveillance video. The recording is then stored in the parking surveillance video folder of the dash cam's built-in storage. In this scenario, the moving object is usually within the dash cam's field of view for an extended period of time.

faqs.question: Why can't I use HDR mode after setting the frame rate to 60 fps?

answer.text: Based on the HDR mode realization principle, the amount of frame encoding calculation is equal to 60 fps under the setting of HDR+30 fps. HDR and 60 fps cannot be enabled simultaneously on mainstream dash cam controllers because the processing capability is insufficient.

faqs.question: What are the advantages of HDR mode?

answer.text: This model is equipped with hardware-level HDR capability, which can greatly optimize the imaging effect in scenarios with strong brightness contrast, such as the following:

items: Entering and exiting tunnels or underground garages during the daytime on a sunny day;
Headlights shining directly on the license plate of the vehicle at night;
Shadow imaging of objects on the road in areas exposed to strong sunlight.

faqs.question: What is the recording duration of the 4K Omni parking surveillance power?

answer.text: When time-lapse mode, motion detection and collision detection are all enabled, the recording duration is 32 hours. With time-lapse and collision detection enabled and motion detection disabled, the recording duration is 46 hours.

faqs.question: Why is my memory card not working?

answer.text: This dash cam model supports 4K 60fps images and requires high-speed memory cards. Use a U3 or higher memory card. Based on the adaptation results of lab tests:

items: Memory cards that work properly in normal lab aging tests: Kingston U3 level 64GB+ memory card, Sandisk U3 level 32GB~256GB memory card, Lexar U3 level 128GB+ memory card;
Not recommended: Samsung memory card (white), KIOXIA memory card, Netac memory card, Transcend memory card

answer.text: Note: Based on the lab test results of purchased samples; the test results for different batches of memory cards may vary.

faqs.question: If I already have an old Omni and a UP03/ UP04/ UP05, do I need to uninstall and reinstall when purchasing a 4K Omni?

answer.text: No, you don't need to repeat the installation. You can just replace the front cam.

faqs.question: I have other 70mai models with rear recording. Can I directly replace the front camera and continue using the same rear camera?

answer.text: No, currently the 4K Omni only supports the RC14 and the dedicated 4K Omni CPL.

faqs.question: Does 4K Omni work well in summer conditions outdoors?

answer.text: 4K Omni use supercapacitor which allowing it to handle more extreme temperatures (-10°C~60°C) and providing better overall performance.
